fields.description: Metrc API base URL. CA Sandbox (test) = https://sandbox-api-ca.metrc.com  |  CA Production (live) = https://api-ca.metrc.com. Defaults to Sandbox — switch to Production deliberately on the live site only.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The vendor / integrator key from Metrc Connect. Auth is HTTP Basic (this key : User API key).
fields.label: API Key (Integrator / Vendor)

fields.description: The per-employee User API key, generated by an Industry Admin from that employee’s profile in the Metrc portal (Admin > API Keys). Must be from the same environment (Sandbox/Production) as the Base URL and vendor key above — falls back to Metrc Settings’ active facility user key if left blank and that doctype exists.
fields.label: API Key (User)

fields.description: Facilities the capabilities panel can query. A licence with no user key of its own uses the User API key above.
fields.label: Licences
